decisions.reason: The glass flake system builds on established two-component spraying know-how, costs little to keep with in-house manufacturing, and two years of website presence is too short to resolve its value in corrosion-protection markets, so the option stays open.
The low-pressure injection pump sits close to the core construction-repair offer, has a dedicated page signalling commitment, and is cheap to maintain, so nothing argues for abandoning it.
Fire protection flow monitoring supports the digitalization direction and serves a regulated niche whose uptake is still uncertain, so keeping this low-cost option preserves upside.
The hydraulic two-component spraying system was only launched in 2024 and is close to the core offer, so its uncertainty is still high and keeping it costs little.
